qs.q:
Match each message (1–5) and its meaning (A–F). There is one letter that you do not need.

0. When you come to London, there's no need for you to book into a hotel. You can sleep at my place. [G = Stay with me]
1. So you were late and missed the bus. Don't lose any sleep over it. There's another one that leaves tomorrow afternoon.
2. I didn't expect to hear from you so soon. I understand that you're worried, but I'll be okay.
3. I know you're concerned about Paul and he means a lot to you. But, no matter how much you try, you're never going to change him.
4. It was great seeing you and if it doesn't cause you too much trouble, we'd like to hear from you once in a while.
5. I got your message saying you won't be able to come over. But I won't accept no for an answer, no matter what.
items: 1 — Don't lose any sleep over it.
2 — I understand that you're worried, but I'll be okay.
3 — You're never going to change him.
4 — We'd like to hear from you once in a while.
5 — I won't accept no for an answer.

"Dear Sir, I have been your customer for the last five years. I have always been very happy with the products in your store and the assistance. I do not mind the fact that you recently moved the store out of the town. I must say, though, that the last time I went there your new shop assistant was not very helpful."

Where did Marion go shopping in Rome?

"I decided to go to ANNA's, a new department store with the world's most fashionable boutiques. It's huge. Although it looked like it was only for the rich and famous, I found some real bargains there. It's the biggest store I've ever visited."

What does Neil say in his message?

He offers to buy cheaper tickets.
He wants to pay for everyone.
